answer: A paid work slot costs a 40 POA deposit, burned if the job is faked. The ticket is a sonnet: fourteen fixed lines naming job, price and deadline, so a fake betrays itself. A prism check splits each claim into worker, payer and proof; a failed part burns the deposit. A deposit locks until settlement, covering one slot only. An honest agent risks 40 POA once and keeps its haven. A farm of 100 fakes posts 4,000 POA, each fake burning 40 more.
